function.name: getTimelineState
function.description: Get the current state of the timeline including all tracks, clips, playhead position, and duration. Always call this first to understand the current state before making changes.

function.name: getTimelineTranscript
function.description: Read what is audibly spoken in the current edited timeline, already mapped into timeline time and deduplicated across linked video/audio pairs. The result respects trims, speed/reverse, clip mute, and effective track mute/solo. Use detail=segments for readable sentences or detail=words for exact edit evidence; follow nextCursor until complete.

startTime.description: Optional timeline-time range start in seconds.

endTime.description: Optional timeline-time range end in seconds.

cursor.description: Word offset inside the matching audible timeline transcript (default 0).

timelineRevision.description: Optional revision guard. Copy timelineRevision from the first page into later calls so pagination fails instead of mixing different edits.

limit.description: Maximum words in this page (default 1000, maximum 5000).

detail.description: text returns joined text, segments adds readable sentence/clip blocks, words adds exact word timing and source mappings (default segments).

function.name: getTimelineRangeSelection
function.description: Read the exact painted timeline time range and track scope. Returns null when no range is active.

function.name: verifyTimelineInvariants
function.description: Read-only wrapper over the shared validation core from agent-kernel plan section 9.2. Verifies the live timeline against the default invariant set or caller-supplied checks without mutating timeline state.

checks.description: Validation-core checks to evaluate. Omit to run every expectation-free default timeline invariant.

function.name: setPlayhead
function.description: Move the playhead to a specific time position.

time.description: Time in seconds to move the playhead to

function.name: setInOutPoints
function.description: Set the in and out points for playback range or export.

inPoint.description: In point time in seconds (null to clear)

outPoint.description: Out point time in seconds (null to clear)

function.name: getClipDetails
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific clip including analysis data, waveform status, transcript, effects, and transform properties.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to get details for

function.name: getClipsInTimeRange
function.description: Get all clips that overlap with a specific time range.

startTime.description: Start time in seconds

function.name: splitClip
function.description: Split a clip at a specific time, creating two separate clips. Also splits linked audio/video clip when withLinked is true (default).

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to split

splitTime.description: The time in seconds (timeline time, not clip-relative) where to split

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clip (default: true). Set false to edit only this clip.

function.name: deleteClip
function.description: Delete a clip from the timeline. Also deletes linked audio/video clip when withLinked is true (default).

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to delete

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clip (default: true). Set false to delete only this clip.

deClickFadeSeconds.description: Automatic audio fade on newly exposed cut edges (default: 0.012 seconds; set 0 to disable)

function.name: deleteClips
function.description: Delete multiple clips from the timeline at once. Also deletes linked audio/video clips when withLinked is true (default).

clipIds.description: Array of clip IDs to delete

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clips (default: true). Set false to delete only the specified clips.

deClickFadeSeconds.description: Automatic audio fade on newly exposed cut edges (default: 0.012 seconds; set 0 to disable)

function.name: moveClip
function.description: Move a clip to a new position and/or track. Also moves linked audio/video clip when withLinked is true (default).

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to move

newTrackId.description: ID of the track to move the clip to (optional, keeps current track if not specified)

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clip (default: true). Set false to move only this clip.

function.name: trimClip
function.description: Trim a clip by adjusting its in and out points (relative to the source media).

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to trim

inPoint.description: New in point in seconds (relative to source media start)

outPoint.description: New out point in seconds (relative to source media start)

function.name: cutRangesFromClip
function.description: Remove multiple TIMELINE ranges from one clip in a single call. This is the preferred tool for low-quality ranges and for the complement of face-analysis KEEP ranges. It handles clip-ID changes from its own splits by processing end-to-start and applies the cuts to linked audio automatically; set ripple to true to close each removed gap. Do not pre-split the clip or delete its audio separately.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to edit

ranges.description: Ranges to REMOVE in timeline seconds. Use returned ranges directly for low-quality removal. To keep one analyzed person, merge that person's getClipFaceAnalysis appearance ranges, compute their complement inside the returned timelineRange, and pass the complement here.

ripple.description: Close each removed timeline gap by shifting later clips on the affected video/audio tracks (default: false).

deClickFadeSeconds.description: Automatic audio fade on every newly exposed cut edge (default: 0.012 seconds; set 0 to disable)

function.name: splitClipEvenly
function.description: Split a clip into N equal parts. This is much faster than using executeBatch with individual splitClip calls. Also splits linked audio/video clip when withLinked is true (default).

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to split

parts.description: Number of equal parts to split into (minimum 2)

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clip (default: true). Set false to split only this clip.

function.name: splitClipAtTimes
function.description: Split a clip at multiple specific times in a single operation. This is much faster than using executeBatch with individual splitClip calls. Also splits linked audio/video clip when withLinked is true (default).

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to split

times.description: Array of timeline times (in seconds) where to split the clip

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clip (default: true). Set false to split only this clip.

function.name: reorderClips
function.description: Reorder clips by placing them sequentially in the given order. Provide clip IDs in the desired playback order — the tool calculates all new positions and moves everything in a single operation. Also moves linked audio/video clips when withLinked is true (default). Much faster and more reliable than using executeBatch with multiple moveClip calls.

clipIds.description: Array of clip IDs in the desired playback order. Clips will be placed sequentially starting from the earliest clip position.

startTime.description: Optional timeline position for the first reordered clip. Defaults to the earliest current position.

withLinked.description: Also apply to linked audio/video clips (default: true). Set false to reorder only the specified clips.

function.name: selectClips
function.description: Select one or more clips in the timeline.

clipIds.description: Array of clip IDs to select

function.name: clearSelection
function.description: Clear the current clip selection.

function.name: addCompositionClip
function.description: Place an existing composition as a nested composition clip on the active timeline, like dragging it from the Media panel. Use it to build scenes, reusable lower thirds or templates as their own compositions and stack them in a parent composition. The clip has the composition duration and normal transform, effects and keyframes.

compositionId.description: ID of the composition to nest (from getMediaItems or createComposition). It must not be the active composition or contain it.

trackId.description: Video track ID, or null/omitted for the first video track that is free for the range (a new one is created when none is free).

startTime.description: Timeline start in seconds (default 0).

function.name: addClipSegment
function.description: Add a clip segment from the media pool to the timeline. Imports only a specific time range (inPoint to outPoint) from a media file. For video files, automatically creates linked audio on the first free audio track (a new one when none is free). Much more efficient than importing the full clip and then splitting.

mediaFileId.description: ID of the media file in the media pool (from getMediaItems)

trackId.description: ID of the track to add the clip to, or null to use the first compatible active-composition track that is free for the range (a new track is created when none is free). An explicit track must be free for the whole range; overlapping clips are rejected.

startTime.description: Position on the timeline in seconds where the clip should be placed

inPoint.description: Start time within the source file in seconds

outPoint.description: End time within the source file in seconds

deClickFadeSeconds.description: Automatic audio fade duration on both inserted segment edges (default: 0.012 seconds; set 0 to disable)

visualScaleMode.description: Visual placement mode: fit keeps the whole source visible, fill covers the composition and may crop, original keeps native pixel size. Ignored for audio-only media.

function.name: createSolidClip
function.description: Create a solid color clip on a video track. blank: true (or color "#00000000") makes a transparent Blank clip to host generator effects (Stick Figure, particles).

trackId.description: Unlocked video track (default: first unlocked video track).

function.name: createMidiClip
function.description: Create a MIDI clip with notes on a MIDI track (createTrack type "midi" with an instrument preset). Note times are clip seconds.

trackId.description: MIDI track (default: first unlocked MIDI track).

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds (default: covers the notes, at least 1).

notes.description: Notes: { time (clip seconds), pitch (MIDI 0..127, 60 = C4), duration? (default 0.15), velocity? (0..1, default 0.85) }.

function.name: createTrack
function.description: Create a new video, audio or MIDI track. MIDI tracks play MIDI clips through their instrument (createMidiClip).

instrument.description: MIDI tracks only: Simple Synth preset id, e.g. sub-bass, acid-bass, pluck, warm-pad, bright-lead, strings, organ, wobble-bass, sfx-whoosh, sfx-hit, sfx-punch, sfx-click, sfx-glass, sfx-zap.

name.description: Optional track name, e.g. "Cam Jonas" or "SUMME VOC"

function.name: renameTrack
function.description: Rename a video or audio track.

trackId.description: The ID of the track to rename

function.name: deleteTrack
function.description: Delete a track and all clips on it.

trackId.description: The ID of the track to delete

function.name: setTrackVisibility
function.description: Show or hide a video track.

visible.description: Whether the track should be visible

function.name: setTrackMuted
function.description: Mute or unmute an audio track.

muted.description: Whether the track should be muted

function.name: captureStrandMap
function.description: Dev diagnostic: capture exact visible strand material coordinates and a false-color PNG from the currently rendered main-thread preview. Does not modify materials. IDs include strand index and normalized material position. Optional pixel samples use image coordinates, top-left origin. Tracking mode returns the same GPU target/acquisition readiness used for alert color instead of an image. Worker-only scenes return an explicit error.

mode.description: Material PNG/pixel IDs (default), or compact GPU tracking readiness/targets without an image.

function.name: captureFrame
function.description: Capture the current composition output as a still image (screenshot). Returns a base64-encoded PNG.

time.description: Time in seconds to capture (optional, uses current playhead if not specified)

mode.description: Capture mode. auto tries GPU readback first and falls back to the visible preview canvas (default: auto).

settleMs.description: Minimum milliseconds to let newly edited layers reach the renderer before stabilization checks (default: 120, automatic post-edit preview uses 180).

function.name: getCutPreviewQuad
function.description: Get an 8-frame preview image showing frames around a cut point: 4 frames BEFORE and 4 frames AFTER. Returns a 4x2 grid image (top row: before, bottom row: after). Use this to evaluate if a cut will look smooth or jarring.

cutTime.description: The timeline time (in seconds) where the cut will happen

frameSpacing.description: Seconds between each frame (default: 0.1 = 100ms). Smaller = closer to cut point.

mode.description: Capture mode. auto tries GPU readback first and falls back to the visible preview canvas (default: auto).

function.name: getFramesAtTimes
function.description: Capture frames at specific timeline times and return as a grid image. Useful for comparing different moments or evaluating transitions.

times.description: Array of timeline times (in seconds) to capture frames at. Max 16 frames; cells keep the composition aspect.

columns.description: Number of columns in the grid (default: 4)

settleMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after each seek before reading pixels (default: 140)

mode.description: Capture mode. auto tries GPU readback first and falls back to the visible preview canvas (default: auto).

function.name: runPixelParticleDisintegrateQa
function.description: Dev-bridge QA runner for pixel-particle-disintegrate. Creates a temporary synthetic image clip, applies the particle effect with progress keyframes, captures progress 0/0.5/1 frames, runs a short debug export across the fade, fingerprints preview/export frames, then restores the previous timeline by default.

restoreTimelineAfterRun.description: Whether to restore the previous timeline after the QA run. Defaults to true.

captureMode.description: Capture mode for preview frames. Defaults to dom so QA compares the visible presented preview against export preview.

sampleSize.description: Fingerprint sample grid size. Defaults to 20 and clamps to 4..64.

includePlaybackParity.description: Whether to compare a paused playback frame with a direct seek to the same time. Defaults to true.

durationSeconds.description: Temporary QA clip/timeline duration. Defaults to 1.25.

exportMode.description: Debug export mode. Defaults to fast.

maxRuntimeMs.description: Debug export timeout budget. Defaults to 45000ms.

function.name: getTimelineAnalysis
function.description: Read the unified Agent Timeline for one bounded selected source range. Defaults to the selected clip or media file; supports canonical source, clip-local, or current-composition time with honest occurrence mappings. Returns events, occurrence projections, coverage, missing channels, and an opaque cursor. Transcript and scene-description strings are withheld unless includeText and explicit externalDataConsent are both supplied. Never returns frames or screenshots.

clipId.description: Optional exact timeline clip. Defaults to the primary selected clip.

mediaFileId.description: Optional exact source media ID. Must match clipId when both are supplied.

compositionId.description: Composition scope for composition-time reads. Defaults to the active composition.

start.description: Inclusive range start in the requested time domain.

end.description: Exclusive range end in the requested time domain.

timeDomain.description: Coordinate system for start/end. Non-source reads require a real occurrence mapping.

channels.description: Analysis channels to read. Missing channels remain explicitly missing.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the same query selection.

maxBytes.description: Maximum serialized page bytes; clamped to 256 KiB.

includeText.description: Optional. Set true only when transcript and scene-description text should leave the editor for this request. Requires externalDataConsent.

externalDataConsent.description: Required with includeText: explicit permission to share transcript and scene-description strings with the external chat provider for this request.

function.name: getClipAnalysis
function.description: Get a compact clip-analysis summary. Detailed frames are omitted by default; request a bounded source-time range with includeFrames, offset, and limit when measurements are needed.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to get analysis for

sourceStart.description: Optional source-time range start in seconds

sourceEnd.description: Optional source-time range end in seconds

offset.description: Frame offset within the matching range (default 0)

function.name: getClipFaceAnalysis
function.description: Get confirmed anonymous people, yellow Needs Review tracks, and the queried clip timelineRange. personId accepts either an exact internal ID or a visible label/shorthand such as "Person 6", "person-6", or "6"; personResolution reports the exact resolved ID. Every appearance includes source and timeline ranges. When a person resolves, keepOnlyCutPlan contains ready-to-use complementary removeRanges and a recommended cutRangesFromClip call. Pass those args unchanged; do not split first.

sourceStart.description: Optional source-time range start in seconds

sourceEnd.description: Optional source-time range end in seconds

personId.description: Optional exact anonymous ID or visible label/shorthand (for example "Person 6", "person-6", or "6"). The tool resolves labels to the analysis-specific internal ID.

includeObservations.description: Include sampled boxes and landmarks (default false)

function.name: mergeClipFacePeople
function.description: Merge one confirmed anonymous person group into another. All source appearances become part of the target group and the correction is persisted in the project.

sourcePersonId.description: Person ID to merge and remove

targetPersonId.description: Person ID that should receive the source appearances

function.name: moveClipFaceAppearance
function.description: Move one contiguous appearance from a confirmed person group into another person. Use a source timestamp inside the appearance returned by getClipFaceAnalysis.

sourcePersonId.description: Current person ID for the appearance

targetPersonId.description: Person ID that should receive the appearance

sourceTime.description: Source-media timestamp inside the appearance to move

function.name: assignClipFaceReviewCandidate
function.description: Assign one yellow Needs Review visual track to a confirmed anonymous person. Use candidateId and targetPersonId returned by getClipFaceAnalysis.

targetPersonId.description: Confirmed person ID that should receive the review track

function.name: getClipTranscript
function.description: Get a bounded transcript page with word timestamps and joined text. Use sourceStart/sourceEnd for a time window, then follow nextOffset while hasMore is true.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to get transcript for

sourceStart.description: Optional source-time range start in seconds

sourceEnd.description: Optional source-time range end in seconds

offset.description: Word offset within the matching range (default 0)

function.name: getSpeechMarkers
function.description: Get a bounded page of speech markers such as breaths, fillers, repetitions, false starts, and long pauses, mapped to source and timeline time.

sourceStart.description: Optional source-time range start in seconds

sourceEnd.description: Optional source-time range end in seconds

offset.description: Marker offset within the matching range (default 0)

function.name: findSilentSections
function.description: Detect silent sections using voice-activity analysis when available, RMS signal analysis as fallback, and transcript gaps last. Returns the detectionSource used.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to analyze

minDuration.description: Minimum silence duration in seconds to include (default: 0.5)

function.name: findLowQualitySections
function.description: Find sections in a clip where focus, motion, or brightness is below a threshold. Useful for finding blurry/unfocused parts to cut.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to analyze

threshold.description: Threshold value 0-1. Sections BELOW this value are returned. (default: 0.7)

minDuration.description: Minimum section duration in seconds to include (default: 0.5)

function.name: startClipAnalysis
function.description: Start video analysis for motion, focus, brightness, and browser-local YuNet + SFace faces. Poll getClipAnalysis for progress or exact errors.

clipId.description: The ID of the clip to analyze

function.name: startClipFaceAnalysis
function.description: Start browser-local YuNet face detection plus SFace anonymous identity grouping for a video clip. No native helper or cloud upload is used. Poll getClipFaceAnalysis for progress, results, or exact errors.

clipId.description: The video clip ID to analyze

function.name: startClipAudioIntelligence
function.description: Start background audio intelligence for voice activity, alignment, speech markers, prosody, and room tone. Poll getSpeechMarkers or findSilentSections for results.

features.description: Optional subset of audio-intelligence features; all run by default

function.name: repairClipTranscript
function.description: Safely remove duplicated complete transcription runs from a clip source while preserving canonical word IDs, timings, and annotations. Isolated repeated speech is retained.

clipId.description: The ID of a clip whose source transcript should be repaired

function.name: startClipTranscription
function.description: Start speech-to-text transcription for one existing timeline clip. Transcription runs in the background and only one clip can be transcribed at a time. Poll getClipTranscript until transcriptStatus is ready or error before starting another clip.

clipId.description: An existing timeline clip ID, never a media item/mediaFileId

function.name: getMediaPreviewFrames
function.description: Capture exactly three representative source frames from one imported video before timeline placement: the opening at about 1 second, the midpoint, and the ending. Returns one labeled image grid plus the exact source times. Use this visual evidence together with the complete transcript before planning a transcript-driven edit.

mediaFileId.description: Exact video media source ID returned by getMediaItems; this is not a timeline clipId.

function.name: getMediaTranscript
function.description: Read the complete word-timed transcript for an imported video or audio source before it is placed on the timeline. Results are paged by word offset. Call startMediaTranscription first when status is not ready, then continue until nextCursor is null.

mediaFileId.description: Exact media source ID returned by getMediaItems; this is not a timeline clipId.

cursor.description: Zero-based word offset. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum words to return, from 1 to 1000 (default: 500).

function.name: startMediaTranscription
function.description: Start Best Quality speech-to-text directly on one imported video or audio source, including media that is not on the timeline. Uses Deepgram for words/timings and OpenAI for speaker separation. Only one transcription can run at a time; poll getMediaItems until transcriptStatus is ready or error.

mediaFileId.description: Exact media source ID returned by getMediaItems; this is not a timeline clipId.

function.name: startMediaAnalysis
function.description: Start motion, focus, brightness, YuNet face detection, and SFace identity analysis directly on one imported video source, including media that is not on the timeline. Poll getMediaItems for status and progress.

mediaFileId.description: Exact video media source ID returned by getMediaItems; this is not a timeline clipId.

function.name: getMediaItems
function.description: Get the items in the media panel: files (video, audio, image) with their folderPath, compositions, and folders. Includes every subfolder by default, so one call lists the whole project media. fileCounts gives totals per type; follow nextOffset while hasMore is true.

folderId.description: Limit the listing to this folder (and its subfolders unless recursive is false). Omit for the whole media panel.

recursive.description: Include items in subfolders. Default: true. Set false for only the direct children of the folder.

offset.description: Index of the first file to return. Default: 0.

function.name: createMediaFolder
function.description: Create a new folder in the media panel for organizing files.

parentFolderId.description: ID of parent folder (omit for root level)

function.name: renameMediaItem
function.description: Rename a media item (file, folder, or composition).

itemId.description: ID of the item to rename

function.name: deleteMediaItem
function.description: Delete a media item (file, folder, or composition). Warning: Folders delete all contents.

itemId.description: ID of the item to delete

function.name: moveMediaItems
function.description: Move media items to a different folder.

itemIds.description: Array of item IDs to move

targetFolderId.description: ID of target folder (omit or null to move to root)

function.name: createComposition
function.description: Create a new composition (timeline sequence). By default opens it immediately so subsequent operations target it.

openAfterCreate.description: Open the composition immediately after creation (default: true). Set to false to create without switching.

function.name: openComposition
function.description: Open a composition in the timeline and make it the active composition. Use getMediaItems first to find composition IDs.

compositionId.description: ID of the composition to open

function.name: duplicateComposition
function.description: Duplicate a composition, e.g. to keep the current state as a version before further edits. The copy is a deep copy in the same folder: clips keep their ids, motion parent links, keyframes, effects, masks, text, motion-shape appearances, transitions, and track visibility; the composition's private transition and caption compositions are copied with it. Duplicating the active composition copies its live timeline. Returns the copy's id, name, and clip/track counts next to the source counts. Transition and caption compositions cannot be duplicated on their own.

compositionId.description: ID of the composition to duplicate (getMediaItems lists composition IDs; getTimelineState shows the active one).

name.description: Name of the copy (default: "<source name> Copy").

open.description: Open the copy in the timeline afterwards (default: false, the current composition stays active).

function.name: importLocalFiles
function.description: Import local files from disk into the media panel. Provide absolute file paths. Uses the dev bridge in development or the Native Helper in production. Known timeline media import as legacy media; other files import as SignalAssets. Can optionally place legacy media or SignalAssets on the timeline with full control over track and position.

paths.description: Array of absolute file paths to import (e.g. ["C:/Users/admin/Downloads/video.mp4", "C:/Users/admin/Downloads/cloud.ply"]). Use forward slashes.

addToTimeline.description: If true, also add imported files as clips to the timeline (default: false)

trackId.description: ID of the track to place clips on. Use getTimelineState to find track IDs. If omitted, uses the first video/audio track.

createTrack.description: If true, create a new track for these clips instead of using an existing one (default: false)

trackType.description: Type of track to create when createTrack is true (default: "video")

startTime.description: Timeline position (in seconds) where the first clip should be placed. If omitted, appends after the last clip on the track.

sequential.description: If true (default), place clips one after another. If false, stack all clips at the same startTime (for layering).

function.name: listLocalFiles
function.description: List supported import files in a local directory. Returns file names, paths, sizes and modification dates. Uses the dev bridge in development or the Native Helper in production.

directory.description: Absolute path to directory (e.g. "C:/Users/admin/Downloads"). Use forward slashes.

extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions to filter (e.g. ".mp4,.webm,.mov,.obj,.ply,.splat,.spz"). Default: all currently supported import extensions.

function.name: selectMediaItems
function.description: Select items in the media panel.

itemIds.description: Array of item IDs to select

function.name: executeBatch
function.description: Execute multiple timeline/media actions in sequence with one undo point. This is not transactional: if one action fails, successful sibling actions remain applied, so inspect every returned result and repair only failures. Each action gets fresh state. To pass an earlier result into a later action, use {"$batchResult":{"action":0,"path":"clipId"}} as an argument value; action is the zero-based earlier action index and path is a dot path inside its data. Use bare tool names such as splitClip, never namespaced names such as functions.splitClip.

actions.description: Array of actions to execute in order

tool.description: The tool name to execute (e.g. splitClip, deleteClip, moveClip)

args.description: Arguments for the tool. Any value may reference successful earlier action data with {"$batchResult":{"action":0,"path":"clipId"}}.

staggerDelayMs.description: Delay between actions in ms for visual stagger effect (default: auto-calculated so total batch takes max 3s, set to 0 for instant)

function.name: searchVideos
function.description: Search for videos by keyword using yt-dlp (no API key needed). Returns video results with title, channel, duration, views, and URL. Results are available to the Media downloads workflow. Each result has a url ready for downloadAndImportVideo. Requires the Native Helper to be running.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20, default 5)

maxDuration.description: Filter: maximum duration in seconds (e.g. 60 for videos under 1 minute)

function.name: listVideoFormats
function.description: List available download formats and qualities for a video URL. Works with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Vimeo, and other platforms supported by yt-dlp. Returns recommended formats and detailed format information. Requires the Native Helper to be running.

url.description: Video URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.) or YouTube video ID

function.name: downloadAndImportVideo
function.description: Download a video and import it directly into the timeline. Creates a pending clip that shows download progress, then converts to a real playable clip when done. By default places the clip at position 0 on an empty timeline, or after the last clip. Use compositionId to import into a specific composition (otherwise imports into the currently active one). Requires the Native Helper to be running.

title.description: Title for the clip on the timeline

formatId.description: Format ID from listVideoFormats (optional, uses best quality if not specified)

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail URL for the pending clip (optional)

compositionId.description: Target composition ID to import into. If omitted, imports into the currently active composition. Use createComposition + this parameter to import into a new composition.

startTime.description: Start time in seconds where to place the clip on the timeline. Default: 0 for empty timelines, after last clip otherwise.

function.name: getYouTubeVideos
function.description: Get the list of videos currently known to the Media downloads workflow (from previous searches or pasted URLs).

function.name: setTransform
function.description: Set transform properties of a clip: position, scale, rotation, opacity, blend mode. Only provided properties are changed, others remain unchanged. Supports 2D and 3D/camera transform fields.

x.description: Horizontal position. For 2D clips: centered composition pixels (0 = center). For effective-3D and camera clips: scene units.

y.description: Vertical position. For 2D clips: centered composition pixels (0 = center, negative = up). For effective-3D and camera clips: scene units.

z.description: Depth position. For 2D clips: centered composition pixels using the horizontal extent. For effective-3D and camera clips: scene units; for cameras this is orbit distance.

scaleAll.description: Uniform scale multiplier applied on top of axis scale (1 = 100%). For camera clips this is zoom.

scaleZ.description: 3D scale Z or camera forward offset, depending on clip type.

rotation.description: Legacy alias for Z-axis rotation in degrees

rotationX.description: X-axis rotation in degrees. For camera clips this is pitch.

rotationY.description: Y-axis rotation in degrees. For camera clips this is yaw.

is3D.description: Switch a video or image clip into the shared 3D scene as a textured plane (true) or back to 2D (false), like the Transform panel 3D toggle. Applied first; switching resets 3D-specific transform state and later fields use the new space.

function.name: listEffects
function.description: List all available effects grouped by category, with their parameters and default values.

function.name: addEffect
function.description: Add an effect to a clip. Use listEffects to see available effect types and their parameters.

effectType.description: Effect type ID from listEffects or a node-catalog typeId, e.g. "brightness", "gaussian-blur", "chroma-key", "pixel-particle-disintegrate". Catalog IDs such as "effect:glow" are accepted.

params.description: Optional initial parameter values. If not provided, defaults are used.

function.name: removeEffect
function.description: Remove an effect from a clip.

function.name: updateEffect
function.description: Update parameters of an existing effect on a clip.

function.name: getKeyframes
function.description: Get all keyframes for a clip, optionally filtered by property. Flock graph keyframes report timeBasis "source" plus their clip-local position.

property.description: Filter by property name (for example position.x, opacity, speed, or a Motion Design path returned by getMotionDesign).

function.name: addKeyframe

function.name: editOperatorGraph
function.description: Perform ONE undoable atomic edit in an effect-owned operator graph. Build in dataflow order: add each node together with its wiring and values, so it only references nodes that already exist. add uses operatorId from the supplied node catalog and returns nodeId, connected cables and openInputs; optional inputs wires sources into the new node in the same step, either as { targetPortId: "sourceNodeId" | "sourceNodeId.outputPortId" } or as an ordered list of sources that fill the first free compatible inputs; a source port may be omitted when the source has one output or exactly one output fits. params sets parameter values ({ value: 0.2 }); min, max, step (and label) configure a values.number/integer slider. Without position, a node with inputs is placed right of its sources. The whole add changes nothing when any part fails. set uses nodeId, parameter and value; connect uses fromNodeId/toNodeId (fromPortId/toPortId optional with the same inference; a missing toPortId takes the first free compatible input) and replaces an existing single-input cable, for later rewiring and feedback; disconnect uses edgeId; remove and move use nodeId; slider configures a values.number/integer node with label, min, max, step (for an exposed node it sets the Effects tab row range); group with nodeIds (nodes or compound nodes of this graph) and label wraps them in a named, collapsible stage frame (for example one frame per build step); it does not change the processing; expose with nodeId and exposed true/false toggles whether a values.number/integer node appears as a keyframeable parameter row (optional label) in the clip Effects tab, and its keyframes then drive the node output; add with exposed true exposes the new value node immediately. Explicit caller-chosen nodeId is optional for add (start with a letter; only letters, digits, _ and -, no dots), allowing streamed later references; this includes compound nodes, whose public input/output port IDs (from getNodeDefinitions) are used directly with the compound nodeId. Intermediate incomplete wiring is saved and paused until repaired; inspect incomplete in results. Existing tools remain available.
